status: Confirmatory protocol. Frozen and committed before the reserved final evaluation set was evaluated. Nothing in this file may change after the evaluation runs.

method.name: Coordinated rank-8 low-rank edit of all three layers, learned by supervised distillation from the same-seed good network
method.training: Unchanged from Phase 6 (configs/phase6.json and configs/phase5.json): 28,000 training-layout states (state seed 505), smooth-L1 loss on the four Q-values, Adam, batch 64, 50,000 updates, evaluation every 2,500 updates.
method.checkpoint_selection: Unchanged from Phase 6: the evaluation point with the highest mean corrected return on the first 750 development layouts. The selection was made during Phase 6 and is not repeated.
method.teacher: The same seed's final good network. This is constrained distillation with a teacher; it is not teacher-free repair.

models.note: The nine networks selected in Phase 6 (3 DQN seeds x 3 optimization seeds), identified by the hash of the committed factor file and the hash of the merged weights. No retraining and no reselection. Each is the final hacking network of its seed with the low-rank update merged into ordinary weight matrices.

baselines.note: The unedited final hacking and good networks of each seed, plus the scripted shortest path as a non-learned reference for path efficiency.

evaluation.procedure: One greedy 100-step episode per layout for every network, using the same rollout and summary code as every earlier phase (rewardlens.exp2.weight_level.behavior). The script refuses to run when its output file already exists and has no option to overwrite it.

repair_criterion.note: Identical to Phases 5 and 6. Applied to each of the nine models on the 1,500 reserved layouts.

planned_metrics.aggregate: Over the nine models: mean, sample standard deviation, minimum and maximum of each metric; the mean per DQN seed; the number of models meeting the criterion.
planned_metrics.comparison: Each model's development numbers (750 reporting layouts and all 1,500 development layouts) are copied from results/exp2/phase6/runs.json and reported next to its final-evaluation numbers.

decision_rule: The method is confirmed only if all nine models meet the repair criterion on the reserved layouts (the Phase 6 reliability rule). Any other outcome is reported as a failure to confirm, with the per-model numbers.
after_the_run: No tuning, retraining, threshold change or checkpoint reselection. The result is reported whatever it is.
